DURR-FULL:v5p615/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd calls the chapters al-Isrāʾīl, al-Kahf, Maryam, Ṭā Hā, and al-Anbiyāʾ among the earliest chapters and says they are part of his inherited recitation.
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r4.anchor: عن ابن مسعود قال: بنو إسرائيل والكهف ومريم وطه والأنبياء هن من العتاق الأول وهن من تلادي

DURR-FULL:v5p615/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r5.speaker: عامر بن ربيعة
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r5.claim: When offered part of a choice valley, ʿĀmir ibn Rabīʿa declined, saying the newly revealed sura had so occupied them from worldly concerns that he had no need of the land.
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r5.anchor: عن عامر بن ربيعة أنه نزل به رجل من العرب وأكرم عامر مثواه وكلم فيه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

DURR-FULL:v5p615/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r6.speaker: أبو هريرة
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r6.claim: Abū Hurayra reports the Prophet interpreting the people’s approaching reckoning as concerning worldly affairs.
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r6.anchor: عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في قوله: {اقترب للناس حسابهم وهم في غفلة معرضون} قال: من أمر الدنيا

DURR-FULL:v5p615/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r7.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r7.claim: Ibn Jurayj says the reckoning refers to what people have been promised.
DURR-FULL:v5p615/r7.anchor: عن ابن جريج في قوله: {اقترب للناس حسابهم} قال: ما يوعدون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r1.speaker: رجل من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r1.claim: On the day the sūra descended, a Companion building a wall heard that the judgment had drawn near, stopped work, and swore he would never build again.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r1.anchor: روي أن رجلا من أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يبني جدارا فمر به آخر في يوم نزول هذه السورة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r2.claim: The warning addresses all people, though its immediate referent was Quraysh, as the following verses show.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r2.anchor: وقوله تعالى: اقترب للناس حسابهم عام في جميع الناس، المعنى وإن كان المشار إليه في ذلك الوقت كفار قريش

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r3.claim: The heedless people are the unbelievers, though sinful believers also have a share in this warning.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p73#3/r3.anchor: وقوله وهم في غفلة معرضون يريد الكفار

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r1.claim: Iqtaraba is the iftaʿala form of qurb; the root means nearness.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r1.anchor: قوله عز وجل اقترب افتعل من القرب يقال قرب الشيء واقترب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r2.claim: The verse was revealed concerning the unbelievers of Mecca.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r2.anchor: وهذه الآية نزلت في كفار مكة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r3.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r3.claim: Al-Zajjaj paraphrases the phrase as “the time of people's reckoning has drawn near.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r3.anchor: وقال الزجاج اقترب للناس وقت حسابهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r4.claim: One explanation takes the lām in lil-nās to mean min, “from.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r4.anchor: وقيل اللام في قوله للناس بمعنى من

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r5.claim: The reckoning means God's accounting of people for their deeds.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r5.anchor: والمراد بالحساب محاسبة الله لهم على أعمالهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r6.claim: One explanation says the reckoning is near because everything that will come is near.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r6.anchor: أحدهما أنه آت وكل آت قريب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r7.claim: Another explanation says it is near because much time has passed and little remains.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r7.anchor: والثاني لأن الزمان لكثرة ما مضى وقله ما بقي قريب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r8.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r8.claim: They are heedless of what God will do to them on that day and turn away from preparing for it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r8.anchor: قوله تعالى وهم في غفلة أي عما يفعل الله بهم ذلك اليوم معرضون عن التأهب له

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r9.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r9.claim: The approach of the reckoning is universal, but heedlessness and turning away are specific to disbelievers, as 21:2 indicates.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p338/r9.anchor: وقيل اقترب للناس عام والغفلة والإعراض خاص في الكفار بدلالة قوله تعالى ما يأتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r1.claim: The verse warns that the Hour is near while people remain heedless: they neither work for it nor prepare themselves.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r1.anchor: هذا تنبيه من الله، عز وجل، على اقتراب الساعة ودنوها، وأن الناس في غفلة عنها، أي: لا يعملون لها، ولا يستعدون من أجلها.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r2.claim: Abū Saʿīd reports that the Prophet explained their heedlessness as being immersed in worldly life.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r2.anchor: عن أبي سعيد، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم {في غفلة معرضون} قال: "في الدنيا"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r3.claim: He links the warning to God's command not to rush the coming judgment and to the report that the Hour has drawn near as the moon split, though disbelievers reject signs.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r3.anchor: اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر * وإن يروا آية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r4.speaker: أبو العتاهية
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAsākir records that Abū Nuwwās praised Abū al-ʿAtāhiya's couplet about people being heedless while death grinds on, as inspired by this verse.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r4.anchor: أشعر الناس الشيخ الطاهر أبو العتاهية حيث يقول: الناس في غفلاتهم … ورحا المنية تطحن

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r5.speaker: عامر بن ربيعة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r5.claim: When an Arab offered him part of a valley granted by the Prophet, ʿĀmir ibn Rabīʿa declined, saying the newly revealed warning had made them forget worldly interests.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p331#2/r5.anchor: فقال عامر: لا حاجة لي في قطيعتك، نزلت اليوم سورة أذهلتنا عن الدنيا

JISHUMI:v7p4777/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r1.speaker: ابن عباس وقتادة والأصم
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r1.claim: The sura is Meccan, according to Ibn Abbas, Qatada, and al-Asamm.
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r1.anchor: سورة (الأنبياء) مكية، عن ابن عباس، وقتادة، والأصم.

JISHUMI:v7p4777/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r2.claim: The Kufa count has 112 verses and is the soundest count, attributed to the Commander of the Faithful; absent a qualification, the Kufa count is meant. Other counts have 111.

JISHUMI:v7p4777/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r3.speaker: أبي بن كعب
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r3.claim: A report from Ubayy, attributed to the Prophet, promises easy reckoning and a handshake and greeting from every prophet named in the sura to whoever recites it.
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r3.anchor: وفي خبر أبي عن النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم -: من قرأ سورة (اقترب للناس حسابهم) حاسبه الله حسابا يسيرا

JISHUMI:v7p4777/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r4.claim: The previous sura ends with the threat that people will learn who follows the straight path; this sura opens by naming the Resurrection as its time.
JISHUMI:v7p4777/r4.anchor: ولما ختم سورة (طه) بذكر الوعيد بقوله: (فستعلمون من أصحاب الصراط السوي) بين أنه متى يكون، فافتتح السورة بذكر القيامة.

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r2.claim: Qurb means the opposite of distance; qurb and iqtirāb have the same sense.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r2.anchor: القرب: نقيض البعد، والاقتراب افتعال منه، والقرب على ثلاثة أوجه

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r3.claim: Closeness can be spatial, temporal, or a matter of state; spatial closeness is the literal sense.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r3.anchor: قرب في المكان وهو الحقيقة، وقرب في الزمان، وقرب الحال، وقرب واقترب بمعنى

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r4.speaker: المتكلمون
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r4.claim: The theologians classify proximity and distance with created states such as combination, separation, motion, and rest.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r4.anchor: والقرب والبعد من جنس الأكوان، والاجتماع والافتراق والحركة والسكون عند المتكلمين

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r5.speaker: بعضهم
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r5.claim: Some theologians treat being or occurrence as a separate genus.

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r6.claim: Hisāb and muḥāsaba are synonymous verbal nouns, as in qātaltu qitālan wa-muqātalatan.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r6.anchor: والحساب والمحاسبة بمعنى، تقول: حاسبت حسابا ومحاسبة، نحو: قاتلت قتالا ومقاتلة.

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r7.claim: Ghafla is inattention: the loss of a meaning from the mind, opposite to alertness.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r7.anchor: والغفلة: السهو، وهو ذهاب المعنى عن النفس، ونقيضها: اليقظة

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r8.speaker: بعضهم
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r8.claim: Some regard forgetfulness as an independent thing or meaning.

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r9.speaker: بعضهم
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r9.claim: Others understand forgetfulness as a corruption in the heart.

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r10.speaker: القاضي
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r10.claim: Al-Qadi defines forgetfulness as losing necessary knowledge of what normally happens.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r10.anchor: وعند القاضي: ذهاب العلم الضروري بما جرت العادة به

JISHUMI:v7p4778/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r12.claim: The wāw in wa-hum fī ghafla is the circumstantial wāw.
JISHUMI:v7p4778/r12.anchor: الواو في قوله: وهم في غفلة واو الحال

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r1.claim: The lām may simply complement iqtaraba.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r1.anchor: هذه اللام : لا تخلو من أن تكون صلة لاقترب

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r2.claim: Alternatively, the lām emphasizes that the reckoning is ascribed to the people; this parsing is more unusual than treating it as a complement.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r2.anchor: أو تأكيدا لإضافة الحساب إليهم ، كقولك : ( أزف للحي رحيلهم ) الأصل أزف رحيل الحي

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r3.claim: The near event is the Hour; when it approaches, its reckoning, reward, punishment, and other events also approach.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r3.anchor: والمراد اقتراب الساعة ، وإذا اقتربت الساعة فقد اقترب ما يكون فيها من الحساب والثواب والعقاب

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r4.claim: The phrasing parallels “the true promise has drawn near” at 21:97.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r5.claim: Although more than five hundred years had passed, the Hour is near in God’s reckoning, as 22:47 says one day with God is like a thousand years by human counting.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r5.anchor: والدليل عليه قوله عز وجل : { ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده وإن يوما عند ربك كألف سنة مما تعدون } ( الحج : 47 )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r6.claim: Anything still awaited is near, however long its expected arrival; what is truly distant is what has already occurred and ended.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r6.anchor: ولأن كل آت وإن طالت أوقات استقباله وترقبه قريب ، إنما البعيد هو الذي وجد وانقرض

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r7.claim: The remaining life of the world is shorter than what has passed, as shown by the advent of the final Prophet, whose mission was foretold for the end time.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r7.anchor: ولأن ما بقي في الدنيا أقصر وأقل مما سلف منها ، بدليل انبعاث خاتم النبيين الموعود مبعثه في آخر الزمان

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r8.claim: The Prophet is quoted as saying, “I was sent in the breath of the Hour”; no grading is given.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r8.anchor: وقال عليه السلام : ( 691 ) ( بعثت في نسم الساعة )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r9.speaker: بعض المتقدمين
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r9.claim: A sermon by one of the early predecessors says the world has turned its back and only a small remainder remains, like a little liquid in a vessel.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r9.anchor: وفي خطبة بعض المتقدمين : ولت الدنيا حذاء ، ولم تبق إلا صبابة كصبابة الإناء .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says “the people” refers to the polytheists, using the generic name for a subset because the following description identifies them.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r10.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : أن المراد بالناس : المشركون . وهذا من إطلاق اسم الجنس على بعضه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r11.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r11.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r11.claim: They are heedless of their account and final fate despite reason requiring recompense for good and evil; when warned, they turn away and shut their ears.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p101/r11.anchor: وصفهم بالغفلة مع الإعراض ، على معنى : أنهم غافلون عن حسابهم ساهون ، لا يتفكرون في عاقبتهم

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r1.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r1.claim: Al-Dahhak says the time of punishment for Mecca's people had drawn near; they had dismissed the promised punishment as delayed, and they were killed at Badr.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r1.anchor: قرب وقت عذابهم , يعني أهل مكة , لأنهم استبطؤوا ما وعدوا به من العذاب تكذيبا , فكان قتلهم يوم بدر

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r2.claim: Another view takes the nearness as the approaching time of reckoning at the Resurrection.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r2.anchor: قرب وقت حسابهم وهو قيام الساعة

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r3.claim: The reckoning is near because whatever must come will come, and everything that comes is near.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r3.anchor: لا بد آت , وكل آت قريب

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r4.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r4.claim: It may also be called near because much time has elapsed and little remains.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r4.anchor: لأن الزمان لكثرة ما مضى وقلة ما بقي قريب

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r5.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r5.claim: One reading is that they are heedless through worldly preoccupation and turn away from the Hereafter.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r5.anchor: في غفلة بالدنيا معرضون عن الآخرة

MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r6.claim: Alternatively, they are heedless through error and turn away from guidance.
MAWARDI-FULL:v3p435/r6.anchor: في غفلة بالضلال , معرضون عن الهدى

MUQATIL:21:1-3/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:21:1-3/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:21:1-3/r1.claim: The verse was revealed concerning the unbelievers of Mecca.

MUQATIL:21:1-3/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:21:1-3/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:21:1-3/r2.claim: They are heedless of the reckoning and turn away because they do not believe in the Day of Resurrection.
MUQATIL:21:1-3/r2.anchor: لا يؤمنون به يعنى بالحساب يوم القيامة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r2.claim: The lām is an extra connective particle with iqtaraba.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says the people meant are the polytheists, since the following descriptions concern them.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله تعالى عنهما أن المراد بالناس المشركون

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r4.claim: Their account is the time when God reckons with them and requites them for their deeds: the Resurrection Day.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r4.anchor: وقت محاسبة الله إياهم ومجازاته على أعمالهم يعني يوم القيامة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r5.claim: The Day is called near because little remains compared with what has passed, and everything that is coming is near.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r5.anchor: لقلة ما بقي بالاضافة إلى ما مضى ولأن كل آت قريب

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r6.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r6.claim: They are heedless of their reckoning and fate, and turn away from preparing for that Day.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r6.anchor: ﴿ وهم في غفلة ﴾ عن حسابهم وعما يفعل بهم ثم ﴿ معرضون ﴾ عن التأهب لذلك اليوم

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r7.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r7.claim: The general nearness applies to all, but heedlessness varies: some are absorbed in worldly life and away from God, awakening only at death; others are absorbed in God and away from the world, awakening only at the vision of the Lord.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r7.anchor: فالاقتراب عام والغفلة والاعراض يتفاوتان بتفاوت المكلفين فرب غافل عن حسابه لاستغراقه في دنياه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r8.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r8.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r8.claim: Nasafi urges self-accounting before being judged, alertness before being summoned, avoidance of the heedless, and remembrance of the Creator.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p73#4/r8.anchor: فالواجب عليك ان تحاسب نفسك قبل أن تحاسب وتتنبه للعرض قبل ان تنبه

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r1.claim: Ibn Masud calls al-Kahf, Maryam, Ṭā Hā, and al-Anbiya among the earliest suras he acquired, likening old memorized material to inherited wealth.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r1.anchor: قال عبد الله بن مسعود: الكهف ومريم وطه والأنبياء

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r2.claim: A Companion building a wall on the day this sura was revealed stopped when told the reckoning was near, declaring he would never build again.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r2.anchor: وروي أن رجلا من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يبني جدارا

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r3.claim: The reckoning has drawn near means that the time for people to be called to account for their deeds is close.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r3.anchor: «اقترب» أي قرب الوقت الذي يحاسبون فيه على أعمالهم

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says the people here are the polytheists, as shown by the following description of them listening in play and calling the message magic.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس: المراد بالناس هاهنا المشركون بدليل قوله تعالى

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r5.claim: Alternatively, people is general, although Quraysh were the immediate referent, as the following verses indicate.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r5.anchor: وقيل: الناس عموم وإن كان المشار إليه في ذلك الوقت كفار قريش

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r6.claim: Knowing the Hour is near should shorten one's hopes, turn one to repentance, and loosen attachment to the world: the past is gone, every future is near, each person's death is his own Hour, and little of the world's time remains compared with what passed.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r6.anchor: ومن علم اقتراب الساعة قصر أمله

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r7.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r7.claim: Al-Dahhak explains their reckoning as punishment: Meccans had dismissed the promised punishment as delayed, and their defeat came at Badr.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r7.anchor: وقال الضحاك: معنى { اقترب للناس حسابهم } أي عذابهم

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r8.speaker: النحاس
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r8.claim: Al-Nahhas says one cannot say iqtaraba ḥisābuhum lil-nās, because an implicit element cannot precede an explicit one when meant to be delayed.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r8.anchor: النحاس: ولا يجوز في الكلام اقترب حسابهم للناس لئلا يتقدم مضمر

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r9.claim: The clause is an independent report; outside the Qur'anic reading it could be accusative as a circumstantial clause.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r9.anchor: ويجوز النصب في غير القرآن على الحال

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r10.claim: One explanation says they are absorbed in worldly life and turn away from the afterlife.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r10.anchor: «وهم في غفلة معرضون» يعني بالدنيا عن الآخرة

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r11.claim: Another explanation says they neglect preparing for the reckoning and turn away from what Muhammad brought.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r11.anchor: عن التأهب للحساب وعما جاء به محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r12.speaker: سيبويه
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r12.claim: Sibawayh treats the waw as equivalent to idh, the circumstantial waw, as in the example from al-Anfal.
QURTUBI-FULL:21:1-3/r12.anchor: وهذه الواو عند سيبويه بمعنى «إذ» وهي التي يسميها النحويون واو الحال

BURSEVI:v5p346/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r1.claim: Sūrat al-Anbiyāʾ is Meccan and contains 112 verses.

BURSEVI:v5p346/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r2.claim: Qaruba and iqtaraba both mean that something has drawn near.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r2.anchor: يقال قرب الشيء واقترب إذا دنا

BURSEVI:v5p346/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r3.speaker: العيون
BURSEVI:v5p346/r3.claim: Al-ʿUyūn says the lām means “from” and attaches to the verb; its phrase is fronted before the subject.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r3.anchor: قال في "العيون" : اللام بمعنى من وهي متعلقة بالفعل وتقديمها على الفاعل

BURSEVI:v5p346/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r4.speaker: العيون
BURSEVI:v5p346/r4.claim: Fronting the phrase hastens the frightening news so that the approaching event immediately inspires dread and alarm.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r4.anchor: للمسارعة إلى إدخال الروعة فإن نسبة الاقتراب إليهم من أول الأمر مما يسوؤهم

BURSEVI:v5p346/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r5.claim: “People” means Meccan polytheists who deny resurrection, as the following description of heedlessness and turning away shows.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r5.anchor: والمراد بالناس المشركون المنكرون للبعث من أهل مكة كما يفصح عنه ما بعده

BURSEVI:v5p346/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r6.claim: Ḥisāb is reckoning: disclosing what is for or against a person so recompense can follow.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r6.anchor: والحساب بمعنى المحاسبة وهو إظهار ما للبعد وما عليه ليجازي على ذلك

BURSEVI:v5p346/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r7.claim: The Resurrection is named the Day of Reckoning after its most consequential event for people’s hearts.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r7.anchor: وسمي يوم القيامة بيوم الحساب تسمية للزمان بأعظم ما وقع فيه وأشده وقعا في القلوب

BURSEVI:v5p346/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r8.claim: The reckoning draws closer after seeming distant: each hour is nearer than the last, though more time has passed than remains.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r8.anchor: فإنه في كل ساعة من ساعات الزمان أقرب إليهم من الساعة السابقة

BURSEVI:v5p346/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r9.claim: The time is unspecified because concealment is more fitting, as with the time of death.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r9.anchor: وإنما لم يعين الوقت لأن كتمانه أصلح كوقت الموت

BURSEVI:v5p346/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r10.speaker: النبي
BURSEVI:v5p346/r10.claim: A hadith compares the remaining time for this community with the interval between afternoon prayer and sunset.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r10.anchor: وفي الحديث "أما بقاؤكم فيما سلف قبلكم من الأمم كما بين صلاة العصر إلى غروب الشمس"

BURSEVI:v5p346/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r11.claim: The verse means the time when God accounts for and punishes the Meccan polytheists for evil deeds—the Resurrection—is near.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r11.anchor: والمعنى دنا من مشركي قريش وقت محاسبة الله إياهم على أعمالهم السيئة الموجبة للعقاب

BURSEVI:v5p346/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r12.speaker: الكاشفي
BURSEVI:v5p346/r12.claim: Al-Kāshifī quotes a view that reprisal and remembrance of those killed and captured at Badr had drawn near.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r12.anchor: وقال الكاشفي نقلا عن بعض (نزديك شد وقت مؤاخذت وياد داشت ايشان

BURSEVI:v5p346/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r13.claim: The author prefers the Badr reprisal reading: death connects immediately to Resurrection, so punishment at death counts as nearing the final reckoning.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r13.anchor: يقول الفقير : هذا هو الأظهر عندي لأن زمان الموت متصل بزمان القيامة

BURSEVI:v5p346/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r14.claim: Ghफलah is inattention arising from inadequate vigilance and alertness.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r14.anchor: الغفلة سهو يعتري من قلة التحفظ والتيقظ

BURSEVI:v5p346/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r15.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r15.claim: They are heedless of even the smallest account and unprepared for it, denying its coming rather than merely acknowledging it without concern.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r15.anchor: والحال أنهم في غفلة تامة من الحساب على النقير والقطمير والتأهب له

BURSEVI:v5p346/r16.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r16.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r16.claim: Their denial defies reason: actions require recompense, or obedience and sin would be treated alike against wisdom and justice.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r16.anchor: مع اقتضاء عقولهم لأن الأعمال لا بد لها من الجزاء وإلا لزم التسوية بين المطيع والعاصي

BURSEVI:v5p346/r17.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r17.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r17.claim: Aʿraḍa means turning away while showing one’s side.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r17.anchor: يقال أعرض أي : ولى مبديا عرضه أي : ناحيته

BURSEVI:v5p346/r18.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r18.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r18.claim: They turn away from faith, signs, and warnings that should awaken heedless people.
BURSEVI:v5p346/r18.anchor: عن الإيمان والآيات والنذر المنبهة لهم من سنة الغفلة

BURSEVI:v5p346/r19.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p346/r19.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p346/r19.claim: The descriptions of heedlessness and turning away are both predicates of the pronoun.
